lines.en: I tap on Futaba's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
: I'm good. How about you, Futaba?
: Did you need something or were you just...calling to chat?
: Just checking to see if you're up to anything tonight.
: Well, you are now. Come over to my place.
: Heheh~ That's a pretty rude way of asking, [futabamaster].
: But sure. I'll head over now. I'm just going to take a quick shower first...
: Sure thing. I'll see you soon.
: So, umm...what's the plan for tonight, [futabamaster]?
How should I spend my time with Futaba?
